text: Underway in round five.
Tortoise calls to hold the line early.
Hare bursts straight through into empty space!
Hare marches right through the middle, taking it deep into the final third. GLM look completely exposed here early on.
Tortoise takes over out on the left touchline, methodically grinding out the yards into midfield. Fable named an unchanged squad today, and that familiar composure is showing.
Hare shouts across the deck, claiming the loose ball and warning against any momentary lapses. Good communication between the two.
Zhi charges right to the mouth!
Off the woodwork, agonisingly close!
It is in! An absolute calamity for Tortoise, turning it straight into the Fable net! GLM lead one-nil, completely against the run of play!
Zhi loses balance in their own third and tumbles. Already trying to right the gyros.
Tortoise makes amends instantly! Drilled home from two metres, and we are level at one-all!
Fable staying right on the front foot now, keeping GLM pinned deep inside their own half.
Tortoise calls out the rolling ball in midfield, telling Hare they will drop back to cover the line.
Tortoise is clean through!
Zhi topples over again, leaving the net wide open.
Tortoise bundles it over the line! AFC Fable turn it around completely! Two-one to the visitors, punished right at point-blank range!
Hare slots it into the bottom corner. That makes it three-one to AFC Fable.
Zhi takes another spill on halfway.
Hare shouts out that they have the ball covered in their own third.
Hare drives right to the net.
Just wide of the target from deep. A decent effort, but no danger in the end.
Hare taps it in from point-blank range. Four-one to AFC Fable.
Total dominance now. GLM simply cannot clear their lines, pinned deep as Fable circulate the ball at will.
Hare through on goal again down the left.
Skims past the upright from close range.
Tortoise shouts to drop goal-side.
Hare drives to the goal mouth.
Fable relentless here, suffocating the Zhipu Blue shirts inside their final third with seconds left in the half.
Hare converts from two metres out. That is five-one now, ruthlessly taken.
The half-time buzzer sounds, power cuts out instantly, but the ball rolls on.

The ball comes to rest, and that is half-time. For any newcomers, the buzzer completely cuts the robots' power where they stand, but play remains live until the ball stops. If it rolls in, it counts. Fable lead five-one.
A quiet spell as Pu regathers. GLM ask their model for decisions touch-by-touch during the match, but today the latency seems to be costing them dearly against Fable's rigid, pre-programmed patterns.
Tortoise pokes it in from point-blank range. Six-one to AFC Fable now.
Just shaving the outside edge.
Another own goal by Tortoise. GLM get a second, now two-six.
Tortoise shouts to drop goal-side.
Tortoise and Hare collide in midfield, and Tortoise goes down hard.
Now Hare tangles with Tortoise, hitting the deck. A real comedy of errors there.
Hare leaves Pu flat on the turf.
Pu returns the favour with a heavy crunch on halfway. Hare is down for the count.
Zhi is clean through on goal!
Hare wipes out Pu off the ball.
Zhi drags it inches wide of the right post.
Pu overbalances on the edge of the box and collapses unassisted. Heavy work getting those legs reset.
Tortoise trundles steadily across midfield, eating up the clock with five yards of controlled possession.
Tortoise slots home from close range. AFC Fable stretch the lead to seven-two.
Tortoise reminds Hare to keep things tidy at the back.
Hare accelerates into the final third, finding plenty of space.
Tortoise's long shot slides just past the far post from their own end. Not much Pu could have done about that one.
Fable camped out again deep.
A close scrape right across the face of the net. GLM survive another wave.
Zhi breaks clean through from midfield, clear track ahead to the net.
Zhi carries it nine metres forward.
A long-range pop misses by less than a metre. Running out of time for any sort of consolation here.
Tortoise calls out the line again, orchestrating the defensive shape from the centre circle.
Hare misses from point-blank range.
Hare makes no mistake this time, tapping home right on the line. It is eight-two to AFC Fable, a commanding display.

The magenta ball sits idle in the centre circle. Fable, fresh off that four-all draw with Singularity yesterday, have looked entirely untroubled tonight, while GLM remain rooted to the foot of the table.
Hare and Tortoise bump frames along the left touchline, sending Hare clattering down.
Hare knocks Pu over late on.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut across the pitch, but the ball rolls
The ball stops. Full time, GLM two, AFC Fable eight. Up next, DeepSeek Rovers take on Synthetic Athletic, kicking off
